gotchas: Start at /premium. Each plan card has 'Start 7-Day free trial' and 'Skip free trial' links; the first 'Skip free trial' is the Fan plan (monthly by default). A cookie/phishing notice dialog has a Continue button; a 'Privacy' cookie dialog on the login page has an OK button.
Signed out, the plan link goes to Create Account; use its 'Log In' link (email + password on one page, submit with Enter). After sign-in it lands on www.crunchyroll.com/payments/checkout.

On /payments/checkout pick the Credit/Debit option (radios are visually hidden; click the visible 'Credit'/'Debit' text). That mounts split Basis Theory iframes, titled for card number, expiration and security code, each holding one input. Expiry is a single MM/YY input. Billing ZIP is a plain page input (accessible name ZIP/postal) and should be filled in an earlier call than the card number.

Observed 2026-10-07 through the proxy (US tunnel, Dallas) with the public test card under a verification-only key: ZIP, expiry, number and security code filled with no error. The final submit button was not identified (it is not a button labelled Subscribe/Start/Confirm/Purchase while the form is filled); stopped there, nothing submitted.
